title: Root normalization of the explicitly transported finite Tate pullback
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and n >= 0 with coefficient ring A as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and use the specified twists and normalization predicates [def-pur-finite-tate-site-comparison]. Fix schemes T and Tprime with l invertible, a morphism v:Tprime -> T, one annihilating level r, and one nonnegative degree k. Given normalized isomorphisms b:nu_T^* B_(r,T)(k) ~= P_T(k) and bprime:nu_Tprime^* B_(r,Tprime)(k) ~= P_Tprime(k), and an etale pullback isomorphism c:v_et^* B_(r,T)(k) ~= B_(r,Tprime)(k) satisfying IsFiniteTateEtalePullback, the explicitly specified isomorphism v_pro^*(b inverse), followed by the canonical comparison/pullback interchange [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], nu_Tprime^*c, and bprime, satisfies IsFiniteTateProPullback. No family in the schemes, no existence of c or b, no exponent transition and no comparison square is asserted.

source.place: Pullback generator calculation in lem-amb-finite-tate-normalized-coherence; Stacks Tags 03PK, 03Q1, 099R and 0GLZ.

proof.text: Identify etale root sections with the sectionwise kernel of multiplication by m on units. The affine root scheme Spec Gamma(T)[t]/(t^m-1), pulled back along T to Spec Gamma(T), is etale since m is invertible. The all-test-scheme representability and its restriction formula give an etale object V with universal root: every m-th root on any pro-etale W is the pullback of that root along a T-map W to V. Take the finite product of k copies of V in T.Etale. Its image under toProEt is the same product, so the r-th projections of the given root-tower tuple are simultaneously pullbacks of a tuple z on this single etale object U. This also handles k=0 by the terminal object, with no cover or infinite-limit interchange.

Apply hb to U, W, its representing map f, the given scalar and tuples z,x. Apply b inverse to that equality. It identifies b inverse of the source pure pro-etale generator with restriction along f of the comparison unit applied to the etale pure generator.

Transpose the canonical comparison/pullback isomorphism under the two composite adjunctions. The unit_conjugateEquiv_symm equation and naturality give its adjunct formula. Evaluating the right-image comparison on an etale test is the identity since both base-change functors choose the same fibre product. Thus the adjunct of the transported map on the comparison unit of an etale section is bprime of the target comparison unit of the adjunct of c on that section. Naturality extends this equation along the arbitrary map f from W to the etale object.

Pull back each etale root z_i using the normalized root comparison of etaleFiniteTwistPullbackData. Its kernel-inclusion law gives the underlying unit formula. The level-r hypothesis on xprime, the equation for z_i on W, and the pullback-map projection equation show that these pulled-back etale roots restrict to the level-r projections of xprime. Apply hc to compute the etale tensor image and hbprime on the base-changed representing map. Naturality of bprime gives exactly the required pro-etale generator equality. The argument uses no positivity of k, nontriviality of the coefficient ring or nonemptiness of T.

proof_origin.place: Tags 040M (example-roots-of-unity), 03PK (Kummer root schemes), 03Q1 (scheme pullback), and 0B65 (lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints). H1: global finite-product root presentation replaces the local-cover/separatedness step; the remaining calculation is the canonical mate unit equation.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_tate_transported_pullback_normalized
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ)
    (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (v : T' ⟶ T)
    (hT : IsUnit (l : Γ(T, ⊤))) (hT' : IsUnit (l : Γ(T', ⊤)))
    (r : ℕ) (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ)
    (b : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k)
    (b' : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T').obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T' (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T' k)
    (hb : IsFiniteTateSiteComparison l E n T r hA k b)
    (hb' : IsFiniteTateSiteComparison l E n T' r hA k b')
    (c : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅
          finiteEtaleTateTwist T' (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k)
    (hc : IsFiniteTateEtalePullback l E n T v r hA k c) :
    IsFiniteTateProPullback l E n T v k
      ((ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).mapIso b.symm ≪≫
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) v).app
            (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≪≫
        (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T').mapIso c ≪≫ b')
